Solve the following:

(0.6 × 0.6 × 0.6 + 0.7 × 0.7 × 0.7)/(0.6 × 0.6 - 0.42 + 0.7 × 0.7)

**Formula Used:**

Perform arithmetic operations (multiplication, addition, and subtraction) as per the given equation.

⇒ Numerator = 0.216 + 0.343

⇒ Numerator = 0.559

Calculate the denominator:

⇒ Denominator = 0.36 - 0.42 + 0.49

⇒ Denominator = -0.06 + 0.49

⇒ Denominator = 0.43

Now, divide the numerator by the denominator:
